verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion control is a fair question for a data platform, but the pack documents no retention policies, purge or VACUUM-style deletion, or deletion controls for data or AI-assistant interactions. Delta table history and time travel (docs-54), Unity Catalog access control and audit logging (docs-38), and the SOC 2 attestation are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
